messages.content: 紐約目前的交通狀況如何？

function.name: geocode_address
function.description: Transforms a description of a location (like a pair of coordinates, an address, or a name of a place) to a location on the Earth's surface. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

address.description: The address that needs to be geocoded.

locale.description: Preferred locale for the returned address information. (Optional) Default: None

message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時取得紐約市的實時交通資訊。若您需要最新的路況、擁堵程度或公共交通延誤，建議使用以下幾種方式：

| 方式 | 主要功能 | 連結 / 應用 |
|------|----------|-------------|
| **Google Maps** | 實時路況、交通流量、公共交通時刻表 | https://maps.google.com |
| **Apple Maps** | 同樣提供即時路況與公共交通資訊 | iOS 內建 |
| **NYC DOT Traffic** | 紐約市交通部門提供的路況圖與事故報告 | https://www.nyc.gov/html/dot/html/home/traffic.shtml |
| **Waze** | 社群即時更新的交通狀況、事故、警察巡邏 | https://www.waze.com |
| **MTA Bus Time / MTA Subway Time** | 公共巴士與地鐵實時到站資訊 | https://mta.info |

如果您想了解某條特定道路（例如百老匯、第五大道、布魯克林橋等）的典型高峰期或常見擁堵時間，我可以提供一般性的資訊。請告訴我您關心的路段或時間，我會盡力協助！

We might want to use the geocode_address function? But the question is about traffic. We don't have a function for traffic. We can answer with general knowledge or say we don't have real-time data. We can ask for clarification or provide typical traffic patterns. We can also mention that we can't fetch real-time data. So respond accordingly.
